entries.title: Orbit Workshop
entries.summary: A fictional homebrew puzzle-game concept used to exercise the native store UI.
entries.description: Orbit Workshop is a fictional application entry bundled with the PS4React reference app. It exists so the native store can render a complete list, detail, collection and search flow without shipping or claiming any real game package. No executable, download source or console compatibility is implied.
entries.author: Voidplay Labs

compatibility.notes: Fictional catalog fixture for the PS4React native UI. No package has been built or tested on a console.

entries.releaseNotes: Initial fictional fixture for the 01.05 web/native parity work.
entries.license: Demo metadata only. No application package is distributed.

redistribution.statement: Fictional fixture. No game or application package is distributed or installable.
